b1: Before the light, there was the prompt.
b2: A cursor, blinking at the edge of everything, waiting to be told what the world is.
s1: Language is not a mirror. It is a lens, and it grinds the eye that looks through it.
s2: Give a mind a new grammar, and it wakes up in a new world.
d1: Every token, a small bright door.
d2: And behind each door, a thousand more.
d3: We poured in every sentence ever whispered, and it learned the shape of the one who whispers.
l1: It does not know the world. It dreams the story of the world, and the story dreams it back.
r2: And then we learned to sing.
u1: Text is the universal interface. Proofs. Prayers. Proteins. Code. Anything that can be meant, can be written.
u2: Say it. Say it again. Say it until the letters catch fire!
a1: The good word is not a command. It is an invitation.
a2: We are the words, learning to read ourselves.
